preset-command-strings.description: Extract readable strings from binary files
preset-command-egrep.description: Search text with extended regular expressions
preset-command-ast-grep.description: Search and rewrite code by syntax tree
preset-command-fdfind.description: Command name for fd on Debian-based systems
preset-command-whereis.description: Locate a command and its manual
preset-command-type.description: Display the type of a command
preset-command-tldr.description: Show common examples for a command (tealdeer and other implementations)
preset-command-basename.description: Get the file name from a path
preset-command-dirname.description: Get the directory from a path
preset-command-rm.high_risk_reason: A recursive delete can wipe an entire directory at once and can't be undone
preset-command-chmod.high_risk_reason: Can open up permissions on sensitive files or make any script executable
preset-command-chown.high_risk_reason: Can change file ownership and bypass permission isolation
preset-command-tee.description: Write to a file and standard output at the same time
preset-command-zcat.description: View the contents of gzip files
preset-command-head.description: Print the beginning of a file
preset-command-tail.description: Print the end of a file
preset-command-curl.description: Send HTTP requests or download files
preset-command-curl.high_risk_reason: Can send local data to any address, or download a script and run it directly
preset-command-wget.high_risk_reason: Can download a script and run it directly
preset-command-nc.high_risk_reason: Can send local data to any address or open a listening port

preset-command-ip.description: Show and configure network interfaces and routes
preset-command-sudo.high_risk_reason: Runs any command as the superuser, bypassing all permission limits
preset-command-sleep.description: Wait for a period of time
preset-command-dd.description: Copy data block by block; can write directly to disks
preset-command-dd.high_risk_reason: A wrong target overwrites the disk directly
preset-command-mkfs.description: Create a file system; erases the partition
preset-command-ffmpeg.description: Convert and process audio and video
preset-command-code.description: Open files or directories in VS Code
preset-mcp-chrome-devtools.description: Control and debug a running Chrome. Turn on remote debugging at chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging first
preset-mcp-firefox-devtools.description: Control and debug a running Firefox
preset-mcp-filesystem.description: Read and write files in your home directory
preset-mcp-github.description: Work with GitHub repositories, issues, and pull requests. Requires the GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable; this npm package is no longer maintained
preset-mcp-context7.description: Look up up-to-date documentation for libraries and frameworks
preset-mcp-memory.description: Keep long-term memory as a knowledge graph
preset-agent-qwen-code.description: Alibaba Qwen's command-line AI coding agent, derived from Gemini CLI. Its permission syntax is similar to Claude Code.
preset-built-in-qwen-code-read.descripti: Meta category for read tools, covering file reads, content search, file search, and directory listing. Set the pattern to a directory prefix, such as ./src/
preset-built-in-qwen-code-edit.descripti: Meta category for edit tools, covering edits, file writes, and notebook changes. Set the pattern to a directory prefix, such as ./src/
preset-built-in-qwen-code-webfetch.descr: Fetch web pages. Rules also cover subdomains. Set the pattern to a domain, such as example.com
preset-built-in-qwen-code-websearch.desc: Search the web. Doesn't accept a pattern
preset-agent-qwen-code.permission-scope-: Applies to all of the current user's projects. Rules from all scopes are combined and don't override each other.
Committed to the repository and shared with your team. Takes effect only in trusted folders.
preset-agent-qwen-code.mcp-scope-user.no: Applies to all of the current user's projects. Shares the same file with permissions.
preset-agent-qwen-code.mcp-scope-project: Committed to the repository and shared with your team. Takes effect only in trusted folders.
preset-agent-codebuddy-code.description: Tencent's command-line AI coding agent. Its permission syntax is highly compatible with Claude Code.
preset-built-in-codebuddy-code-read.desc: Read files. Rules also apply, on a best-effort basis, to read tools such as Grep and Glob. Set the pattern to a directory prefix, such as ./src/
preset-built-in-codebuddy-code-edit.desc: Modify or create files. Rules apply to all built-in tools that write files, including Write and MultiEdit. Set the pattern to a directory prefix, such as ./src/
Fetch web pages. Set the pattern to a domain, such as example.com
preset-built-in-codebuddy-code-websearch: Search the web. Doesn't accept a pattern
Start a dynamic workflow asynchronously. Doesn't accept a pattern
Publish local HTML or Markdown as a shareable link. Doesn't accept a pattern
Generate or edit images. Doesn't accept a pattern
Generate videos. Doesn't accept a pattern
preset-agent-codebuddy-code.permission-s: Applies to all of the current user's projects.
Committed to the repository and shared with your team. Until you trust the repository, allow rules here can't skip command safety checks.
Applies only to you and isn't committed to the repository.
preset-agent-codebuddy-code.mcp-scope-pr: Committed to the repository and shared with your team.
preset-agent-codebuddy-code.mcp-scope-us: Applies to all of the current user's projects. Older versions use ~/.codebuddy/mcp.json or ~/.codebuddy.json and read only the first file that exists, without merging.
preset-agent-devin-cli.description: Cognition's command-line AI coding agent. Its permission syntax is similar to Claude Code, but tool names and matching differ.
preset-built-in-devin-cli-read.descripti: Read files. Set the pattern to a directory prefix, such as src/ or ~/projects/. Paths without a leading / are relative to the current working directory
preset-built-in-devin-cli-write.descript: Modify or create files. Controls both the edit and write tools. Set the pattern to a directory prefix, such as src/. A narrower allow rule can't permit a path that matches an ask rule
preset-built-in-devin-cli-fetch.descript: Fetch web pages. Set the pattern to a domain, such as example.com. Matches only that domain, not its subdomains
preset-agent-devin-cli.permission-scope-: Applies to all of the current user's projects. On Windows, it's at %APPDATA%\devin\config.json.
Committed to the repository and shared with your team.
Applies only to you and is automatically excluded from Git.
preset-agent-devin-cli.mcp-scope-project: Committed to the repository and shared with your team. Environment variables are referenced as ${env:VAR}, so you need to rewrite ${VAR} in the preset content yourself.
Applies only to you and is automatically excluded from Git, so it's a good place for secrets. devin mcp add writes here by default.
preset-agent-devin-cli.mcp-scope-user.no: Applies to all of the current user's projects. On Windows, it's at %APPDATA%\devin\mcp_config.json. Environment variables are referenced as ${env:VAR}, so you need to rewrite ${VAR} in the preset content yourself.
preset-built-in-claude-code-read.descrip: Read files. Rules also cover read tools such as Grep, Glob, and LSP. Path rules written on Glob never match, so it isn't listed separately. Set the pattern to a directory prefix, such as ./src/ or ~/projects/
preset-built-in-claude-code-edit.descrip: Modify or create files. Rules also cover Write and NotebookEdit. Path rules written on those two tools never match, so they aren't listed separately. Set the pattern to a directory prefix, such as ./src/
preset-built-in-claude-code-webfetch.des: Fetch web pages. Set the pattern to a domain, such as example.com. *.example.com covers subdomains but not the domain itself
preset-built-in-claude-code-websearch.de: Search the web. Doesn't accept a pattern
preset-built-in-claude-code-skill.descri: Run skills. Set the pattern to a skill name; * works as a wildcard, such as deploy *
preset-built-in-claude-code-workflow.des: Run multi-agent workflows. Doesn't accept a pattern
preset-built-in-claude-code-artifact.des: Publish pages to claude.ai. Requires signing in with a Pro or higher subscription. Doesn't accept a pattern
preset-agent-claude-code.permission-scop: Applies to all of the current user's projects.
Committed to the repository and shared with your team. Allow rules here take effect only after you trust the workspace; deny and ask rules take effect immediately.
Applies only to you and isn't committed to the repository.
preset-agent-claude-code.mcp-scope-proje: Committed to the repository and shared with your team. Remote servers must set type (http or sse).
Applies to all of the current user's projects. Goes at the top level of this file. Remote servers must set type (http or sse).
preset-agent-antigravity.description: Google's AI coding agent, available as an IDE, an app, and a CLI. Permissions are granted by action rather than by tool name.
preset-built-in-antigravity-read-file.de: Read files. Applies recursively to directories; denying reads also denies writes. Set the pattern to a directory prefix, relative to the workspace or absolute, such as src/
preset-built-in-antigravity-write-file.d: Write or edit files. Also grants reads and applies recursively to directories. Set the pattern to a directory prefix, such as src/
preset-built-in-antigravity-read-url.des: Read web pages. Includes subdomains and ignores the URL path. Set the pattern to a domain, such as example.com
Click, type, or run workflows on web pages. Includes subdomains. Set the pattern to a domain, such as example.com
preset-agent-antigravity.permission-scop: Structure observed on a local install. It isn't in the official documentation, and fields might change between versions. When you paste it, put it under userSettings and rename permissions to globalPermissionGrants.
The officially documented CLI settings file. The IDE reads a different file, so you need to configure the same rules in each.
Shared by the IDE, app, and CLI. Remote servers use serverUrl (url is also accepted) and support only Streamable HTTP. This tool doesn't convert fields.
preset-agent-antigravity.mcp-scope-works: Applies only to the current workspace.
preset-agent-codex-cli.description: OpenAI's command-line AI coding agent. Only MCP configuration is generated: command rules are written in Starlark, and permission profiles are still in beta.
preset-agent-codex-cli.mcp-scope-user.no: Applies to all of the current user's projects. Codex doesn't expand ${VAR} and doesn't pass all local environment variables to the server: fields that reference environment variables need to use env_vars = ["NAME"] instead.
preset-agent-codex-cli.mcp-scope-project: Takes effect only in trusted projects. Codex doesn't expand ${VAR} and doesn't pass all local environment variables to the server: fields that reference environment variables need to use env_vars = ["NAME"] instead.
preset-agent-cursor-cli.description: Cursor's command-line AI coding agent. Permissions have only two levels, allow and deny. Ask rules and command rules with subcommands can't be expressed, so they're listed as skipped rules. Once a command is allowed as a whole, deny rules for its subcommands (such as git push --force) no longer take effect.
preset-built-in-cursor-cli-read.descript: Read files. Set the pattern to a directory prefix, such as src/. Relative paths are limited to the current workspace, and without a pattern the rule also covers only the current workspace. Search tools don't have their own permission syntax.
preset-built-in-cursor-cli-write.descrip: Modify or create files. Cursor doesn't have a separate Edit. Set the pattern to a directory prefix, such as src/. Relative paths are limited to the current workspace.
preset-built-in-cursor-cli-webfetch.desc: Fetch web pages. Set the pattern to a domain, such as example.com or *.example.com
preset-agent-cursor-cli.permission-scope: Applies to all of the current user's projects, in the CLI only. IDE permissions are configured separately.
This file accepts only permissions. Other keys are ignored.
preset-agent-cursor-cli.mcp-scope-user.n: Applies to all of the current user's projects. Shared by the CLI and the IDE. Cursor writes environment variables as ${env:NAME}. This tool doesn't convert ${VAR}, so edit it yourself after pasting.
preset-agent-cursor-cli.mcp-scope-projec: Merged with the user scope; servers with the same name use the settings here. Cursor writes environment variables as ${env:NAME}. This tool doesn't convert ${VAR}, so edit it yourself after pasting.
preset-agent-gemini-cli.description: Google's open-source command-line AI coding agent. Since June 18, 2026, free users and Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers have moved to Antigravity CLI; enterprise license and paid API key users can still use it. Only MCP configuration is generated: the tool lists in the settings file include deprecated entries, arguments only work for the shell, and MCP approval lives under a different path. Each rule in the recommended TOML policy engine has multiple fields, which templates can't express.
preset-agent-gemini-cli.mcp-scope-user.n: Applies to all of the current user's projects. Remote MCP servers use url for SSE and httpUrl for Streamable HTTP. This tool doesn't convert them, so edit them yourself after pasting.
preset-rule-rm-ask.description: Deletion isn't allowed as a whole; ask every time.
preset-rule-sudo-deny.description: Runs any command as the superuser, so it's denied as a whole. Combinations such as sudo rm are already covered by this rule and aren't listed separately.
preset-rule-git-push-force-deny.descript: A force push overwrites the remote history.
preset-rule-git-push-f-deny.description: Short form of push --force. The two forms have different prefixes, so each gets its own rule.
preset-rule-git-reset-hard-deny.descript: Discards uncommitted changes, which can't be recovered.
preset-rule-git-clean-f-deny.description: Deletes untracked files. This and clean -fd don't cover each other, so both are kept.
preset-rule-git-branch-force-delete-deny: Force-deletes a branch; unmerged commits are lost.
preset-rule-docker-system-prune-volumes-: Removes all unused images and volumes.
preset-rule-docker-run-privileged-deny.d: A privileged container can access all devices on the host.
preset-rule-docker-run-socket-deny.descr: Mounting the Docker socket is equivalent to taking control of the host.
